title: List inline edit: drop the Options menu's dead toggle props and retire the toggle's two pack words
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTC8kn7AdeMpMmyhJG

Filing gate: ④ child of the coordination parent #35683 (list inline-edit redo). Source: topic #35683. Follow-up of PR #35747 (#35684 + #35687). The seat ordered it filed rather than carried in that PR.

## What is left

PR #35747 removes the list page's inline-edit mode and both of its toggles. `ListView` stops passing the toggle props to the Options menu, so the menu's toggle row is never drawn. The PR leaves `ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` alone because, at claim time, PR #35646 was rewriting it (#35646 has since merged). What stays behind, read at PR #35747 head `ef7ba2b4` (re-read on main before working):

- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx`: the `showInlineEdit`, `inlineEdit` and `setInlineEdit` props and the toggle row they gate (test id `toolbar-inline-edit-toggle`).
- The language-pack keys `list.inlineEditShort` and `list.inlineEditLabel` in all 11 locale packs. #35747 keeps them on purpose, so its `Clause-②` stays a pure widening.
- `ListViewProps.onInlineEditChange` (deprecated by #35747 and never called) and the `'inlineEdit'` member of `ListPersonalizationPart`.

## Why

Nothing changes for a user. A developer or an AI author reading the Options menu's props, the list's props or the packs still finds a toggle that no longer exists. They can wire it back, or write `onInlineEditChange` and expect it to be called.

## Done when

- The three props, the row, `onInlineEditChange`, the `'inlineEdit'` personalization member and the two keys are gone, or each one that stays names its reader.
- Removing published props and pack keys narrows the public surface. The claim reads `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, so the PR owes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` L2 and a breaking changeset that carries the FROM → TO line for each removed name.

Blocked-by: #35747

Grading: area:ux · Task · p3 · reach: no user-visible effect (dead props and published words left by a merged removal) · evidence: read on the PR #35747 branch at `ef7ba2b4`.

Reader: area b1-I of repo:objectstack#1 once PR #35747 merges, or the `domain:ui` lane.

Dedupe: `showInlineEdit` (objectstack issues, open and closed) → 1 (#35684, the parent removal itself); `inlineEditLabel` → 1 (#35684); `"inline edit" toggle` open → 4, none about these props.
